title: Foxn3 is part of a transcriptional network that regulates primary cilia in the developing retina.
authors: Zhang, Huanqing; Nair, Thejas; Meng, Fan; Turner, David L
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Foxn3转录因子与Rfx3蛋白在视网膜纤毛基因调控中的互作，涉及TF-DNA结合与AlphaFold 3结构预测，但核心是转录调控网络而非TF-DNA结合位点或动态互作机制建模，方法上仅用AlphaFold预测，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Analysis of retinas from mice with a targeted disruption of the gene encoding the forkhead transcription factor Foxn3 revealed additional displaced amacrine interneurons and retinal astrocytes in the inner plexiform and ganglion cell layers, as well as ectopic primary cilia on bipolar and amacrine interneurons. Foxn3 is a transcriptional repressor and numerous genes linked to cilia structure or assembly were upregulated in embryonic retinas without Foxn3 , including Foxj1, a forkhead transcription factor required for motile cilia. CUTCRUN analysis revealed that many of the upregulated retinal genes were bound by the Foxn3 and Rfx3 proteins. A short hydrophobic motif (LXXLXWL) shared by the Foxj1, Foxn4, and Foxn3 proteins was found to be required for association with the Rfx3 protein and for transcriptional repression by Foxn3, as well as for full transcriptional activation by Foxn4 with Rfx3. AlphaFold 3 predicts an interaction between the shared hydrophobic motif and the Rfx3 dimerization domain. Mutations in Rfx3 at the predicted interaction site disrupted association of Rfx3 with Foxn3 or Foxn4. These results reveal a new layer of transcriptional regulation of genes required for cilia, with Foxn3 functioning as a repressor of cilia genes and limiting primary cilia formation in the developing retina.
abstract_zh: 对靶向破坏编码叉头转录因子Foxn3基因的小鼠视网膜分析显示，在内丛状层和神经节细胞层中出现了额外的移位无长突中间神经元和视网膜星形胶质细胞，以及在双极和無长突中间神经元上出现异位初级纤毛。Foxn3是一种转录抑制因子，在缺乏Foxn3的胚胎视网膜中，许多与纤毛结构或组装相关的基因上调，包括Foxj1，一种运动纤毛所需的叉头转录因子。CUT&RUN分析显示，许多上调的视网膜基因被Foxn3和Rfx3蛋白结合。发现Foxj1、Foxn4和Foxn3蛋白共有的一个短疏水基序（LXXLXWL）对于与Rfx3蛋白的关联、Foxn3的转录抑制以及Foxn4与Rfx3的完全转录激活是必需的。AlphaFold 3预测该共有疏水基序与Rfx3二聚化结构域之间存在相互作用。在预测相互作用位点的Rfx3突变破坏了Rfx3与Foxn3或Foxn4的关联。这些结果揭示了纤毛所需基因转录调控的新层面，其中Foxn3作为纤毛基因的抑制因子，限制发育中视网膜的初级纤毛形成。
